cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because Message is null
cases.description: Calling apply with a null Message should be rejected immediately.

cases.expected: Message contains a TSIGRecord with algorithm HMAC_SHA256 and error code 0
cases.description: When old TSIGRecord is null the method should create a fresh TSIGRecord using the default algorithm.

cases.expected: Message contains a TSIGRecord whose error field equals 9 (BADTIME)
cases.description: The method must propagate the supplied error code into the generated TSIGRecord.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because error code is out of range
cases.description: Negative error codes are invalid and should cause an exception.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord added with a full MAC (signature) covering the whole message
cases.description: When fullSignature defaults to true, the MAC must be calculated over the entire DNS message.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord added with a truncated MAC (only the first 10 bytes) because fullSignature is false
cases.description: When the overloaded apply(..., false) is used, the signature should be shortened according to the DNS TSIG spec.

cases.expected: New TSIGRecord re‑uses the key name and algorithm from the old record and updates the time field
cases.description: If an old TSIGRecord is supplied, the new record must inherit its key name and algorithm while refreshing the timestamp.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because the old record is older than the allowed FUDGE (300 s)
cases.description: The method must reject an old TSIGRecord whose timestamp is outside the acceptable time window.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord uses the MD5 algorithm for MAC generation
cases.description: Verify that algorithmToName correctly resolves the MD5 constant and the MAC is generated with HMAC‑MD5.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because algorithm name cannot be mapped to a known Name
cases.description: When an unsupported algorithm string is supplied the method should fail fast.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord is added; its time field equals Instant.now() (within a few ms) and no exception is thrown
cases.description: Old TSIGRecord timestamp exactly at the lower bound of the allowed fudge (300 s) should be accepted.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because the old record is older than the allowed FUDGE (300 s)
cases.description: Old TSIGRecord timestamp just beyond the fudge window must be rejected.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because the old record timestamp is in the future
cases.description: TSIG must not accept a record whose time is ahead of the current time.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord is generated using HMAC‑SHA‑512; MAC length equals 64 bytes
cases.description: Verify that the method correctly selects the SHA‑512 algorithm when the old record specifies it.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because algorithm is null
cases.description: A null algorithm in the old TSIGRecord must cause immediate failure.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because key name is empty or invalid
cases.description: Empty key names are not permitted for TSIG.

cases.expected: New TSIGRecord re‑uses key name 'custom.example.' and algorithm HMAC_SHA1; timestamp is refreshed
cases.description: When a valid old record is supplied, its key name and algorithm must be preserved.

cases.expected: Message contains a TSIGRecord whose error field equals 16 (BADKEY)
cases.description: The method must propagate any valid DNS error code, not only 0 or 9.

cases.expected: Message ends with exactly one TSIGRecord; its MAC differs from 'oldMac' (new signature replaces the old one)
cases.description: apply should overwrite any pre‑existing TSIGRecord rather than leaving duplicates.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord is successfully added; no exception is thrown and MAC length matches algorithm digest size
cases.description: Ensures that MAC calculation works for messages with a large number of records.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because secret key length is zero
cases.description: A TSIGRecord with an empty secret cannot be used to generate a MAC.

cases.expected: TSIGRecord added with a MAC that is exactly 10 bytes long (truncated signature)
cases.description: When fullSignature is false, the MAC must be truncated to the first 10 bytes as required by the TSIG spec.

group: Default Algorithm When Old Is Null

cases.expected: Generated TSIGRecord uses algorithm HMAC_SHA256 (the library default)
cases.description: If no previous TSIGRecord is supplied, the method should fall back to HMAC‑SHA‑256.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because secret key is null
cases.description: When the supplied old TSIGRecord has a null secretKey the apply method must reject the call.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because timestamp is null
cases.description: apply must validate that the old record's time field is non‑null; a null timestamp should cause an exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because key name is null
cases.description: A null keyName in the old TSIGRecord is invalid and must be rejected.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because key name is not a valid DNS name
cases.description: TSIG requires the key name to be a fully qualified domain name; a plain string without a trailing dot should cause an exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because the algorithm cannot be instantiated by JCE
cases.description: When the algorithm name maps to a Name that is not supported by the underlying JCE provider, apply must fail with an exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because error code exceeds the maximum allowed value
cases.description: apply should validate that the DNS error code is within the range defined by the protocol; an excessively large value must be rejected.
